full_judgment:
Mirza Hussain Haider J. This civil review petition for leave to appeal is directed for reviewing the judgment and order dated 24.08.2015, passed by the Appellate Division in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 1396 of 2015, which has been dismissed for being barred by limitation. 

 6. The said civil petition was heard by the Appellate Division on 24.08.2015 and the same was dismissed as being barred by limitation without touching the merit of the case. Hence this civil review petition for leave to appeal.
